title: Open an application
caption: App Launcher shows the applications available to this user.

title: A list contains several records
caption: Recently Viewed is a view, not an inventory of every accessible contact.

title: Create one fictional contact
caption: Enter values for one person. Saving a record does not add a new field.

title: Inspect the stored contact
caption: Details displays field values for Irina SAM Demo.

title: Inspect related work
caption: Related displays associated records. These lists can be empty.

title: Recognize the configuration area
caption: Setup changes how the org works. Daily customer work happens in the application.

title: Inspect the object definition
caption: Fields & Relationships defines the structure used by Contact records.
